11 # Basic theory of bornology
12 
13 We develop the basic theory of bornologies. Instead of axiomatizing bounded sets and defining
14 bornologies in terms of those, we recognize that the cobounded sets form a filter and define a
15 bornology as a filter of cobounded sets which contains the cofinite filter.  This allows us to make
16 use of the extensive library for filters, but we also provide the relevant connecting results for
17 bounded sets.
18 
19 The specification of a bornology in terms of the cobounded filter is equivalent to the standard
20 one (e.g., see [Bourbaki, *Topological Vector Spaces*][bourbaki1987], **covering bornology**, now
21 often called simply **bornology**) in terms of bounded sets (see `Bornology.ofBounded`,
22 `IsBounded.union`, `IsBounded.subset`), except that we do not allow the empty bornology (that is,
23 we require that *some* set must be bounded; equivalently, `∅` is bounded). In the literature the
24 cobounded filter is generally referred to as the *filter at infinity*.
25 
26 ## Main definitions
27 
28 - `Bornology α`: a class consisting of `cobounded : Filter α` and a proof that this filter
29   contains the `cofinite` filter.
30 - `Bornology.IsCobounded`: the predicate that a set is a member of the `cobounded α` filter. For
31   `s : Set α`, one should prefer `Bornology.IsCobounded s` over `s ∈ cobounded α`.
32 - `bornology.IsBounded`: the predicate that states a set is bounded (i.e., the complement of a
33   cobounded set). One should prefer `Bornology.IsBounded s` over `sᶜ ∈ cobounded α`.
34 - `BoundedSpace α`: a class extending `Bornology α` with the condition
35   `Bornology.IsBounded (Set.univ : Set α)`
36 
37 Although use of `cobounded α` is discouraged for indicating the (co)boundedness of individual sets,
38 it is intended for regular use as a filter on `α`.
39 -/
40 
41 @[expose] public section
42

44 open Set Filter
45 
46 variable {ι α β : Type*}
47 
48 /-- A **bornology** on a type `α` is a filter of cobounded sets which contains the cofinite filter.
49 Such spaces are equivalently specified by their bounded sets, see `Bornology.ofBounded`
50 and `Bornology.ext_iff_isBounded` -/
51 class Bornology (α : Type*) where
52   /-- The filter of cobounded sets in a bornology. -/
53   cobounded (α) : Filter α
54   /-- The cobounded filter in a bornology is smaller than the cofinite filter. -/
55   le_cofinite (α) : cobounded ≤ cofinite
56 
57 @[ext]
58 lemma Bornology.ext (t t' : Bornology α)
59     (h_cobounded : @Bornology.cobounded α t = @Bornology.cobounded α t') :
60     t = t' := by
61   cases t
62   cases t'
63   congr
64 
65 /-- A constructor for bornologies by specifying the bounded sets,
66 and showing that they satisfy the appropriate conditions. -/
67 @[simps, implicit_reducible]
68 def Bornology.ofBounded {α : Type*} (B : Set (Set α))
69     (empty_mem : ∅ ∈ B)
70     (subset_mem : ∀ s₁ ∈ B, ∀ s₂ ⊆ s₁, s₂ ∈ B)
71     (union_mem : ∀ s₁ ∈ B, ∀ s₂ ∈ B, s₁ ∪ s₂ ∈ B)
72     (singleton_mem : ∀ x, {x} ∈ B) : Bornology α where
73   cobounded := comk (· ∈ B) empty_mem subset_mem union_mem
74   le_cofinite := by simpa [le_cofinite_iff_compl_singleton_mem]
75 
76 /-- A constructor for bornologies by specifying the bounded sets,
77 and showing that they satisfy the appropriate conditions. -/
78 @[simps! cobounded, implicit_reducible]
79 def Bornology.ofBounded' {α : Type*} (B : Set (Set α))
80     (empty_mem : ∅ ∈ B)
81     (subset_mem : ∀ s₁ ∈ B, ∀ s₂ ⊆ s₁, s₂ ∈ B)
82     (union_mem : ∀ s₁ ∈ B, ∀ s₂ ∈ B, s₁ ∪ s₂ ∈ B)
83     (sUnion_univ : ⋃₀ B = univ) :
84     Bornology α :=
85   Bornology.ofBounded B empty_mem subset_mem union_mem fun x => by
86     rw [sUnion_eq_univ_iff] at sUnion_univ
87     rcases sUnion_univ x with ⟨s, hs, hxs⟩
88     exact subset_mem s hs {x} (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hxs)

93 /-- `IsCobounded` is the predicate that `s` is in the filter of cobounded sets in the ambient
94 bornology on `α` -/
95 def IsCobounded [Bornology α] (s : Set α) : Prop :=
96   s ∈ cobounded α
97 
98 /-- `IsBounded` is the predicate that `s` is bounded relative to the ambient bornology on `α`. -/
99 def IsBounded [Bornology α] (s : Set α) : Prop :=
100   IsCobounded sᶜ
101 
102 variable {_ : Bornology α} {s t : Set α} {x : α}
103 
104 theorem isCobounded_def {s : Set α} : IsCobounded s ↔ s ∈ cobounded α :=
105   Iff.rfl
106 
107 theorem isBounded_def {s : Set α} : IsBounded s ↔ sᶜ ∈ cobounded α :=
108   Iff.rfl
109 
110 @[simp]
111 theorem isBounded_compl_iff : IsBounded sᶜ ↔ IsCobounded s := by
112   rw [isBounded_def, isCobounded_def, compl_compl]
113 
114 @[simp]
115 theorem isCobounded_compl_iff : IsCobounded sᶜ ↔ IsBounded s :=
116   Iff.rfl
117 
118 alias ⟨IsBounded.of_compl, IsCobounded.compl⟩ := isBounded_compl_iff
119 
120 alias ⟨IsCobounded.of_compl, IsBounded.compl⟩ := isCobounded_compl_iff
121 
122 @[simp]
123 theorem isBounded_empty : IsBounded (∅ : Set α) := by
124   rw [isBounded_def, compl_empty]
125   exact univ_mem
126 
127 theorem nonempty_of_not_isBounded (h : ¬IsBounded s) : s.Nonempty := by
128   rw [nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
129   rintro rfl
130   exact h isBounded_empty
131 
132 @[simp]
133 theorem isBounded_singleton : IsBounded ({x} : Set α) := by
134   rw [isBounded_def]
135   exact le_cofinite _ (finite_singleton x).compl_mem_cofinite
136 
137 theorem isBounded_iff_forall_mem : IsBounded s ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, IsBounded s :=
138   ⟨fun h _ _ ↦ h, fun h ↦ by
139     rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩
140     exacts [isBounded_empty, h x hx]⟩
141 
142 @[simp]
143 theorem isCobounded_univ : IsCobounded (univ : Set α) :=
144   univ_mem
145 
146 @[simp]
147 theorem isCobounded_inter : IsCobounded (s ∩ t) ↔ IsCobounded s ∧ IsCobounded t :=
148   inter_mem_iff
149 
150 theorem IsCobounded.inter (hs : IsCobounded s) (ht : IsCobounded t) : IsCobounded (s ∩ t) :=
151   isCobounded_inter.2 ⟨hs, ht⟩
152 
153 @[simp]
154 theorem isBounded_union : IsBounded (s ∪ t) ↔ IsBounded s ∧ IsBounded t := by
155   simp only [← isCobounded_compl_iff, compl_union, isCobounded_inter]
156 
157 theorem IsBounded.union (hs : IsBounded s) (ht : IsBounded t) : IsBounded (s ∪ t) :=
158   isBounded_union.2 ⟨hs, ht⟩
159 
160 theorem IsCobounded.superset (hs : IsCobounded s) (ht : s ⊆ t) : IsCobounded t :=
161   mem_of_superset hs ht
162 
163 theorem IsBounded.subset (ht : IsBounded t) (hs : s ⊆ t) : IsBounded s :=
164   ht.superset (compl_subset_compl.mpr hs)
165 
166 @[simp]
167 theorem sUnion_bounded_univ : ⋃₀ { s : Set α | IsBounded s } = univ :=
168   sUnion_eq_univ_iff.2 fun a => ⟨{a}, isBounded_singleton, mem_singleton a⟩
169 
170 theorem IsBounded.insert (h : IsBounded s) (x : α) : IsBounded (insert x s) :=
171   isBounded_singleton.union h
172 
173 @[simp]
174 theorem isBounded_insert : IsBounded (insert x s) ↔ IsBounded s :=
175   ⟨fun h ↦ h.subset (subset_insert _ _), (.insert · x)⟩
176 
177 theorem comap_cobounded_le_iff [Bornology β] {f : α → β} :
178     (cobounded β).comap f ≤ cobounded α ↔ ∀ ⦃s⦄, IsBounded s → IsBounded (f '' s) := by
179   refine
180     ⟨fun h s hs => ?_, fun h t ht =>
181       ⟨(f '' tᶜ)ᶜ, h <| IsCobounded.compl ht, compl_subset_comm.1 <| subset_preimage_image _ _⟩⟩
182   obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := h hs.compl
183   rw [subset_compl_comm, ← preimage_compl] at hts
184   exact (IsCobounded.compl ht).subset ((image_mono hts).trans <| image_preimage_subset _ _)
185 
186 end
187 
188 theorem ext_iff' {t t' : Bornology α} :
189     t = t' ↔ ∀ s, s ∈ @cobounded α t ↔ s ∈ @cobounded α t' :=
190   Bornology.ext_iff.trans Filter.ext_iff
191 
192 theorem ext_iff_isBounded {t t' : Bornology α} :
193     t = t' ↔ ∀ s, @IsBounded α t s ↔ @IsBounded α t' s :=
194   ext_iff'.trans compl_surjective.forall
195 
196 variable {s : Set α}
197 
198 theorem isCobounded_ofBounded_iff (B : Set (Set α)) {empty_mem subset_mem union_mem sUnion_univ} :
199     @IsCobounded _ (ofBounded B empty_mem subset_mem union_mem sUnion_univ) s ↔ sᶜ ∈ B :=
200   Iff.rfl
201 
202 theorem isBounded_ofBounded_iff (B : Set (Set α)) {empty_mem subset_mem union_mem sUnion_univ} :
203     @IsBounded _ (ofBounded B empty_mem subset_mem union_mem sUnion_univ) s ↔ s ∈ B := by
204   rw [isBounded_def, ofBounded_cobounded, compl_mem_comk]
205 
206 variable [Bornology α]
207 
208 theorem isCobounded_biInter {s : Set ι} {f : ι → Set α} (hs : s.Finite) :
209     IsCobounded (⋂ i ∈ s, f i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, IsCobounded (f i) :=
210   biInter_mem hs
211 
212 @[simp]
213 theorem isCobounded_biInter_finset (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → Set α} :
214     IsCobounded (⋂ i ∈ s, f i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, IsCobounded (f i) :=
215   biInter_finset_mem s
216 
217 @[simp]
218 theorem isCobounded_iInter [Finite ι] {f : ι → Set α} :
219     IsCobounded (⋂ i, f i) ↔ ∀ i, IsCobounded (f i) :=
220   iInter_mem
221 
222 theorem isCobounded_sInter {S : Set (Set α)} (hs : S.Finite) :
223     IsCobounded (⋂₀ S) ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, IsCobounded s :=
224   sInter_mem hs
225 
226 theorem isBounded_biUnion {s : Set ι} {f : ι → Set α} (hs : s.Finite) :
227     IsBounded (⋃ i ∈ s, f i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, IsBounded (f i) := by
228   simp only [← isCobounded_compl_iff, compl_iUnion, isCobounded_biInter hs]
229 
230 theorem isBounded_biUnion_finset (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → Set α} :
231     IsBounded (⋃ i ∈ s, f i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, IsBounded (f i) :=
232   isBounded_biUnion s.finite_toSet
233 
234 theorem isBounded_sUnion {S : Set (Set α)} (hs : S.Finite) :
235     IsBounded (⋃₀ S) ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, IsBounded s := by rw [sUnion_eq_biUnion, isBounded_biUnion hs]
236 
237 @[simp]
238 theorem isBounded_iUnion [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set α} :
239     IsBounded (⋃ i, s i) ↔ ∀ i, IsBounded (s i) := by
240   rw [← sUnion_range, isBounded_sUnion (finite_range s), forall_mem_range]
241 
242 lemma eventually_ne_cobounded (a : α) : ∀ᶠ x in cobounded α, x ≠ a :=
243   le_cofinite_iff_eventually_ne.1 (le_cofinite _) a
244 
245 end Bornology
246 
247 open Bornology
248 
249 theorem Filter.HasBasis.disjoint_cobounded_iff [Bornology α] {ι : Sort*} {p : ι → Prop}
250     {s : ι → Set α} {l : Filter α} (h : l.HasBasis p s) :
251     Disjoint l (cobounded α) ↔ ∃ i, p i ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (s i) :=
252   h.disjoint_iff_left
253 
254 theorem Set.Finite.isBounded [Bornology α] {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) : IsBounded s :=
255   Bornology.le_cofinite α hs.compl_mem_cofinite
256 
257 nonrec lemma Filter.Tendsto.eventually_ne_cobounded [Bornology α] {f : β → α} {l : Filter β}
258     (h : Tendsto f l (cobounded α)) (a : α) : ∀ᶠ x in l, f x ≠ a :=
259   h.eventually <| eventually_ne_cobounded a
260 
261 instance : Bornology PUnit :=
262   ⟨⊥, bot_le⟩
263 
264 /-- The cofinite filter as a bornology -/
265 abbrev Bornology.cofinite : Bornology α where
266   cobounded := Filter.cofinite
267   le_cofinite := le_rfl
268 
269 /-- A space with a `Bornology` is a **bounded space** if `Set.univ : Set α` is bounded. -/
270 class BoundedSpace (α : Type*) [Bornology α] : Prop where
271   /-- The `Set.univ` is bounded. -/
272   bounded_univ : Bornology.IsBounded (univ : Set α)
273 
274 /-- A finite space is bounded. -/
275 instance (priority := 100) BoundedSpace.of_finite {α : Type*} [Bornology α] [Finite α] :
276     BoundedSpace α where
277   bounded_univ := (toFinite _).isBounded
278 
279 namespace Bornology
280 
281 variable [Bornology α]
282 
283 theorem isBounded_univ : IsBounded (univ : Set α) ↔ BoundedSpace α :=
284   ⟨fun h => ⟨h⟩, fun h => h.1⟩
285 
286 theorem cobounded_eq_bot_iff : cobounded α = ⊥ ↔ BoundedSpace α := by
287   rw [← isBounded_univ, isBounded_def, compl_univ, empty_mem_iff_bot]
288 
289 variable [BoundedSpace α]
290 
291 theorem IsBounded.all (s : Set α) : IsBounded s :=
292   BoundedSpace.bounded_univ.subset s.subset_univ
293 
294 theorem IsCobounded.all (s : Set α) : IsCobounded s :=
295   compl_compl s ▸ IsBounded.all sᶜ
296 
297 variable (α)
298 
299 @[simp]
300 theorem cobounded_eq_bot : cobounded α = ⊥ :=
301   cobounded_eq_bot_iff.2 ‹_›
302 
303 end Bornology
